compliance.load_failed: We couldn't load this queue. Please refresh.

exports.title: Export requests
exports.subtitle: Data-subject access and portability requests (GDPR art. 15/20).

erasures.title: Erasure queue
erasures.subtitle: Accounts waiting to be erased, and the holds that stop them (GDPR art. 17).

empty.pending: No account is waiting out its grace period.
empty.ready: No account is ready to be erased.

state.pending: Waiting. The grace period ends on {date}.
state.ready: The grace period has ended and nothing stands in the way.
state.blocked: The grace period has ended, but it cannot be erased: {reasons}.

in_progress.db_done: The database step is done, but the last step did not finish. This needs an engineer: follow the erasure runbook.
in_progress.incomplete: The last run stopped before it finished. Review the plan and confirm again.
in_progress.waiting: Waiting for the erasure worker to pick it up.
in_progress.waiting_stuck: Waiting for over an hour: the erasure worker may be down. Check it (see the erasure runbook), then review the plan and confirm again.
in_progress.running_stuck: Erasing has been running for over an hour and may have stopped. Review the plan and confirm again.

blocker.payment: a payment is still in progress
blocker.delivered_work: delivered work has not been completed
blocker.vendor: a payout provider account is still connected
blocker.not_erasable: it has no creator profile to erase

hold.title: Place a hold
hold.description: While an account is on hold, nobody can erase it. The creator is told nothing, and can still cancel a deletion request: the hold stays.

release.title: Release the hold
release.description: The account can be erased again once its grace period has ended.

dialog.no_personal_details: Do not write names, email addresses or other personal details here: the reason is kept in the audit log permanently.

erase.title: Erase this account
erase.warning: This permanently erases the account: its personal data, its files and its sign-in. It cannot be undone. Each open assignment is cancelled, and its agency is told.
erase.not_ready: This account is not ready to be erased: {reasons}.
erase.retry_note: An earlier erasure of this account stopped. Review the plan, then confirm again.

summary.rows: Database rows to change: {rows}, in {tables} tables.
summary.assignments: Open assignments to cancel: {count}. Each one tells its agency.
summary.read: Rows read to work this out: {rows}.

erase.ulid_label: Type the account id to confirm
erase.mfa_hint: A recovery code is used up when you submit it.

erasures.capped: Only the first {count} accounts that are due are checked at a time. Handle these, then reload.
erasures.action_failed: This could not be saved. Please try again.

reason.not_requested: it never asked to be deleted
reason.grace_running: its grace period has not ended
reason.audit_scrub_unavailable: the audit-log step is not available here

watch.completed: The account was erased. Each cancelled assignment told its agency.
watch.released: The erasure did not start: the data changed since the plan, or a check now refuses. Nothing was erased, and the creator can still cancel. Review the plan and try again.

hold.claimed: This account is already being erased, so it cannot be held.

execute.disabled: Erasing from the admin is switched off. A platform admin turns it on in Feature flags, with a reason, for one named account.
execute.ulid_mismatch: The id you typed does not match this account.
execute.not_ready: This account is not ready to be erased.
execute.in_progress: An erasure of this account is already in progress.
execute.mfa_required: Enter a two-factor code or a recovery code.
execute.mfa_rate_limited: Too many wrong codes. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.
execute.mfa_suspended: Your two-factor sign-in is suspended. Ask another platform admin to reset it.
execute.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait an hour, then try again.

plan.not_available: This account cannot be planned for erasure.
plan.rate_limited: Too many plan requests. Wait a minute, then try again.
